acs.AC-001.1: WHEN an Admin opens , THE frontend SHALL display a User List containing only accounts returned for the current Workspace.
acs.AC-001.2: WHEN an Admin submits a search or changes role, status or Department filters, THE frontend SHALL request and display the matching users using URL-backed filter state.
acs.AC-001.3: WHEN an Admin changes the page or sort order, THE frontend SHALL request the corresponding results with 20 rows per page by default and preserve that state in the URL.
acs.AC-001.4: WHEN the users request is pending, THE frontend SHALL display the existing loading state.
acs.AC-001.5: IF the users request fails, THEN THE frontend SHALL display the catalog error and a retry action.
acs.AC-001.6: IF no users match the request, THEN THE frontend SHALL display MSG04.
acs.AC-001.7: IF the signed-in user lacks the Admin role, THEN THE existing route guard SHALL prevent access to the User List and User Detail routes.
acs.AC-002.1: WHEN an Admin chooses to add a user, THE frontend SHALL open the creation mode of User Detail at .
acs.AC-002.2: WHEN an Admin submits a new account, THE frontend SHALL validate required inputs, email format and the SRS email limit of 100 characters using catalog messages.
acs.AC-002.3: IF an email is outside the Workspace domain or already belongs to an account, THEN THE mock API SHALL reject creation and THE frontend SHALL display the corresponding catalog validation message without losing form input.
acs.AC-002.4: WHEN a new account is created, THE mock API SHALL include the Employee role and THE frontend SHALL prevent removing that baseline role.
acs.AC-002.5: IF the Project Manager role is selected without a Department, THEN THE frontend SHALL prevent submission and identify the missing field.
acs.AC-002.6: WHEN an Admin assigns Knowledge Manager Spaces, THE frontend SHALL use API-provided options and THE mock API SHALL enforce at most one Knowledge Manager per Space, returning MSG117 for conflicts.
acs.AC-002.7: WHEN creation succeeds, THE frontend SHALL invalidate affected user queries and display the catalog success feedback.
acs.AC-002.8: IF the email belongs to a Deactivated account, THEN THE mock API SHALL reject duplicate creation with MSG111 so the Admin can reactivate the existing account.
acs.AC-003.1: WHEN an Admin activates a Deactivated account, THE frontend SHALL submit the change and refresh its detail and affected list queries after success.
acs.AC-003.2: WHEN an Admin deactivates an account with no Active Project or managed Space requiring handover, THE frontend SHALL request confirmation using MSG57 before submitting the change.
acs.AC-003.3: IF the target is the last Active Admin, THEN THE mock API SHALL reject deactivation and THE frontend SHALL display MSG56.
acs.AC-003.4: IF the target is the current Admin, THEN THE frontend SHALL disable self-deactivation with MSG112.
acs.AC-003.5: WHEN a Project Manager with Active Projects or a Knowledge Manager with managed Spaces is deactivated, THE frontend SHALL open Hand Over Responsibilities with MSG_NEW_2 and require eligible recipients for every responsibility before completion.
acs.AC-003.6: IF no eligible replacement exists, THEN THE frontend SHALL block completion and display MSG59 for Project Managers or MSG118 for Knowledge Managers.
acs.AC-003.7: WHEN deactivation succeeds, THE mock API SHALL retain the account and its responsibility/history references rather than delete the user.
acs.AC-003.8: IF a status update fails or is cancelled, THEN THE frontend SHALL retain the last confirmed status and allow retry without reporting success.
acs.AC-004.1: WHEN an Admin opens an existing User Detail, THE frontend SHALL load the selected user's roles, status, Department and managed Spaces from the API.
acs.AC-004.2: WHEN an Admin saves role and assignment changes, THE mock API SHALL retain Employee, require a Department for Project Managers and enforce one Knowledge Manager per Space.
acs.AC-004.3: WHEN a role or assignment change removes managed responsibilities, THE frontend SHALL require the existing D3 handover flow before submitting the completed change.
acs.AC-004.4: IF an Admin attempts to remove their own Admin role, THEN THE frontend SHALL disable that action with MSG113.
acs.AC-004.5: WHEN removing a Ticket Resolver role affects Project membership, THE frontend SHALL request confirmation with MSG78 before submitting the change.
acs.AC-004.6: WHEN a role update succeeds, THE frontend SHALL invalidate affected list, detail and session queries so subsequent mock requests use the updated permissions.
acs.AC-004.7: IF updating roles or assignments fails, THEN THE frontend SHALL preserve the unsaved form and display the API's catalog error without committing partial changes.
